detail.longDescription: The point of the homecomputers of the 70ies and 80ies was to democratize programming. Something that was only possible at universities and big companies was now available and accessible to everyone. If you turned on a random 8bit-computer, the chances were good that you were greeted by a Basic interpreter, inviting you to code. 🧵 4/5 # noai # coding # programming # retrocomputing # homecomputer
